title: Egg White Omelet + Greek Yogurt
ingredients: Salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste
steps: Whisk the egg whites and whole egg in a bowl. Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium.
Add spinach and tomato; sauté for 2 minutes until softened.
Pour in the eggs. Cook for 3–4 minutes until set, folding in half.
Serve with ½ cup fat-free Greek yogurt on the side.

title: Fat-Free Greek Yogurt with Berries
steps: Combine the Greek yogurt and berries in a bowl.
Drizzle with honey and mix well.

title: Egg White Scramble + Turkey Slices
ingredients: 1 cup chopped vegetables (bell peppers, onions, spinach)
steps: Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium.
Add chopped vegetables and sauté for 3–4 minutes until tender.
Pour in egg whites, season with salt and pepper, and cook while stirring until fully set.
Serve with sliced turkey breast on the side.

title: PBfit Yogurt with Protein Powder
steps: Combine the Greek yogurt, protein powder, PBfit, and cocoa powder in a bowl.
Add cacao nibs and mix well.

title: Egg White Omelet with Veggies
ingredients: 1 cup chopped vegetables (bell peppers, onions, spinach)
steps: Whisk the egg whites in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium.
Add chopped vegetables and sauté for 2 minutes until softened.
Pour in the eggs. Cook for 3–4 minutes until set, folding in half.

title: Greek Yogurt Parfait with Berries
steps: Layer Greek yogurt, berries, and granola in a glass or bowl.
Drizzle with honey.

title: Egg Whites + Whole Egg with Spinach
steps: Whisk the egg whites and whole egg in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
Add spinach to a nonstick skillet over medium heat until wilted.
Pour in the eggs and cook for about 3–4 minutes until set.

title: Citrus Grilled Turkey Breast Salad
steps: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, and cucumber.
Slice the grilled turkey breast and add it to the salad.
Drizzle with light vinaigrette dressing and olive oil.
Toss gently to combine. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Tuna Salad with Celery & Lettuce
steps: In a bowl, combine drained tuna, diced celery, light mayonnaise, and lemon juice.
Mix well until all ingredients are evenly combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the tuna salad over a bed of chopped romaine lettuce.

title: Italian Grilled Chicken Salad
steps: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, and red onion.
Slice the grilled chicken breast and add it to the salad.
Drizzle with light Italian dressing and olive oil.
Toss gently to combine. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Green Goddess Turkey Breast Salad
steps: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, diced avocado, and cucumber.
Add sliced turkey breast to the salad.
Drizzle with green goddess dressing and olive oil.
Toss gently to combine. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Large Lemon Pepper Tuna Salad
steps: In a bowl, combine drained tuna, lemon pepper seasoning, and light vinaigrette dressing.
Mix well until all ingredients are evenly combined.
Serve over chopped romaine with cherry tomatoes and red onion.

title: Baked Bourbon Salmon with Veggies
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Place salmon on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Bake salmon 15–20 minutes until cooked through.
Steam broccoli until tender.
Roast sweet potatoes with a drizzle of olive oil until soft.
Serve salmon with broccoli and sweet potatoes.

title: Balsamic Grilled Chicken Salad
steps: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, and cucumber.
Slice the grilled chicken breast and add it to the salad.
Drizzle with balsamic vinaigrette and olive oil.
Toss gently. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Baked Tilapia with Broccoli & Zucchini
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Place tilapia on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Bake 12–15 minutes or until fish flakes easily.
Steam broccoli and sauté zucchini until tender.

title: Lemon Pepper Chicken with Asparagus
steps: Season chicken with lemon pepper and salt.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook chicken 6–7 minutes per side until cooked through.
In the same skillet, sauté asparagus 3–4 minutes until tender.

title: Garlic Baked Cod & Steamed Spinach
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Place cod on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Bake 12–15 minutes or until fish flakes easily.
Steam spinach until wilted.

title: Teriyaki Shrimp Stir-Fry & Veggies
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (bell peppers, broccoli, snap peas)
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add mixed vegetables and stir-fry 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add shrimp and cook 2–3 minutes until pink.
Pour in teriyaki sauce and cook 2 minutes more.

title: Cajun Grilled Chicken & Broccoli
steps: Season chicken with Cajun seasoning and salt.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook chicken 6–7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Steam broccoli until tender.

title: Thai Turkey Basil Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (bell peppers, onions, snap peas)
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add ground turkey and cook until browned.
Add mixed vegetables and stir-fry 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Pour in soy sauce and cook 2 minutes more.
Garnish with fresh basil.

title: Baked White Fish with Veggies
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (zucchini, bell peppers, cherry tomatoes)
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Place fish on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Bake 12–15 minutes or until fish flakes easily.
Roast mixed vegetables with olive oil until tender.
